visual_specs.title: SkyHarbor Air Context Strength by Dimension
visual_specs.purpose: Show which knowledge dimensions have strong versus weak evidence foundations across the enterprise.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: No certified numeric scores exist; qualitative status cards are the appropriate representation.
visual_specs.placement: Home page hero section above use-case cards
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Planning-grade only; no dimension is certified as production-ready evidence.

visual_specs.title: Knowledge Dimension Readiness: SkyHarbor Air
visual_specs.purpose: Display readiness status across all nineteen knowledge dimensions using qualitative confidence tiers.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Readiness tiers are qualitative; no numeric scores are validated for matrix charting.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge home page as primary navigation orientation visual
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All dimensions are planning-grade or needs-validation; none are certified.

visual_specs.title: Top Evidence Requests Blocking AI Progress
visual_specs.purpose: Surface the highest-priority evidence gaps preventing use-case advancement across all seven programs.
data_requirements: responsible team or domain per gap
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Evidence gaps are qualitative; no numeric priority scores are validated for charting.
visual_specs.placement: Home page below context strength snapshot as a priority action card stack
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Gaps are planning-grade hypotheses until validated by real documents or certified data.

visual_specs.title: SkyHarbor Air AI Use Case Portfolio Overview
visual_specs.purpose: Map all seven use cases by category, system dependency, and evidence readiness status.
data_requirements: evidence readiness status per use case
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Use case readiness is qualitative; no numeric readiness scores are certified for charting.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge use-case section as primary portfolio orientation card grid
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All use cases are planning-grade; none have certified production readiness.

visual_specs.title: Risk and Control Coverage Across Use Cases
visual_specs.purpose: Highlight unmitigated risk areas across vendor, data, AI governance, and operational safety domains.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Control status is qualitative and unvalidated; heatmap uses categorical risk tiers only.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge risk section as primary risk orientation visual for CXO review
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Risk status is hypothesis-grade; no controls are certified as effective without audit evidence.

visual_specs.title: Vendor Dependency and Contract Validation Status
visual_specs.purpose: Show dependency concentration across eight vendors and flag unvalidated contract terms per vendor.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Dependency levels are qualitative assessments; no certified spend or SLA data supports numeric charting.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge vendor section as primary vendor risk orientation matrix
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Vendor analysis is planning-grade; no contract terms are legally validated at this stage.

visual_specs.title: Data Foundation Gaps Across AI Use Cases
visual_specs.purpose: Map uncertified data domains to dependent use cases to show compounding data risk exposure.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Data certification status is qualitative; no completeness scores are validated for numeric display.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge data section as primary data readiness orientation visual
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All data domains are needs-validation; no domain has certified lineage or completeness proof.

visual_specs.title: Nexus Module Next Actions for SkyHarbor Air
visual_specs.purpose: Show which Nexus modules should act next and what evidence gates must clear before activation.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Module activation status is qualitative; no numeric readiness scores support charting.
visual_specs.placement: Home page bottom section as a prioritized action roadmap card stack
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Module actions are advisory; Source activation requires evidence gate clearance per use case.

visual_specs.title: Value Hypothesis Versus Proof Status by Use Case
visual_specs.purpose: Contrast stated value hypotheses against current evidence proof status for each use case.
data_requirements: value hypothesis statement per use case
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Value proof is qualitative and unvalidated; no audited savings or outcomes support numeric comparison.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge value section as primary hypothesis-to-proof orientation visual for finance stakeholders
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All value claims are hypothesis-grade; no realized savings or outcomes are claimed.

visual_specs.title: Evidence Confidence by Domain and Use Case
visual_specs.purpose: Rate evidence confidence across data, contract, process, and governance domains per use case.
data_requirements: confidence tier per domain-use case intersection
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Confidence tiers are qualitative assessments; no validated scores support numeric matrix charting.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge evidence section as primary confidence orientation matrix for CDAO and CIO review
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Confidence ratings are planning-grade; all cells require real evidence validation to upgrade status.

visual_specs.title: Program Readiness Across Seven Strategic Initiatives
visual_specs.purpose: Assess readiness of each program across data, governance, system, and stakeholder dimensions.
data_requirements: readiness status per dimension per program
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Program readiness is qualitative; no certified milestone or completion data supports numeric charting.
visual_specs.placement: Knowledge programs section as primary readiness orientation matrix for CIO and PMO review
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: All programs are planning-grade; no program has certified readiness for production deployment.

visual_specs.title: CXO Insight Cards: SkyHarbor Air Priorities
visual_specs.purpose: Deliver concise executive insight cards summarizing top risks, gaps, and next actions for CXO audiences.
visual_specs.why_chart_allowed_or_not: Insight cards are narrative and qualitative; no numeric data supports chart-based CXO summary display.
visual_specs.placement: Home page primary section as the first CXO-facing content block above all other visuals
visual_specs.evidence_boundary: Insights are advisory and planning-grade; no claims reflect certified outcomes or validated decisions.
